description.en: Peak/valley electricity meter for the DSH composer: a plain-text balance in the footer (orange below ¥10, red below ¥5, blinking below ¥2; click to top up) and a rounded, 80%-width 24h peak/valley timeline on hover, with 5s official balance refresh and independent spend metering. Adapted for DSH 0.2.
description.zh: DSH 输入框右下角的峰谷电表：底栏纯文字余额（<¥10 橙 / <¥5 红 / <¥2 闪烁，点击直达充值）+ 悬停时沿输入卡片下沿浮现的 80% 宽圆角 24 小时峰谷时间轴，官方余额 5 秒刷新，今日消耗独立计费。已适配 DSH 0.2。

description.en: A plain-text balance in the composer footer (bottom-right): no background box, same 13px size as the status row, bold; orange below ¥10, red below ¥5, blinking below ¥2, and the whole text opens the official top-up page. Hover it for a rounded, 80%-width 24h peak/valley timeline along the composer card's bottom edge with a live marker, official balance refreshed every 5s, and today's spend metered from llm/stream. Handles the official weekend all-off-peak rule (since 2026-08-23) in both the timeline and billing; 10 color presets plus custom peak/valley colors.
description.zh: 输入框右下角（底栏）纯文字余额：无背景框，与状态行同字号（13px）加粗；<¥10 橙色、<¥5 红色、<¥2 红色闪烁，整枚文字点击直达官方充值页。悬停时沿输入卡片下沿浮现 80% 宽、四角圆角的 24 小时峰谷时间轴（峰橙/谷蓝 + 当前时刻指针），官方余额 5 秒刷新，今日消耗由 llm/stream 独立计费。时间轴与计费都遵循官方周末全天低谷规则（2026-08-23 起）；内置 10 套配色并支持自定义峰/谷色。
